utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard folks are still lining up with tools and spare parts, and there’s talk the repair drive might pick up after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Let’s keep the plan steady and see how the afternoon goes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Aye, that sounds right. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear the line start moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just give me the quick version and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need you at the repair drive. Bring your tools and I’ll point you at the first job.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll swing by with my tools and grab the first job when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not taking this on faith—can you confirm the repair drive details and point me to the source?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d rather pin down the exact details first, and I can point you to the source once I’ve got it in hand. Let’s make sure we’re working from the first version we were given.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Fair enough—once you have the first version, send it over with the source and I’ll review it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, though I may need a reminder of when and where we’re doing it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve only noted that we’re doing a repair drive; I haven’t written the time or place yet. I’ll add those as soon as they’re settled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s kind of you, Cleo. Just let me know the time and place when you have them, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before I commit to anything. What’s confirmed so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I don’t have anything confirmed yet—I may be a bit behind on the latest update. I should check the drive details and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—please check and send me only the confirmed details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late to this—what’s the plan for the repair drive so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s still coming together, but the main plan is to collect tools and supplies first, then match them with the folks who know what to fix.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help with that. Who’s handling the tools list, and where should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — happy to help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to handle first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — could you start by sorting the tools and laying out the easy fixes? I’m loose on timing, so just jump in wherever it’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll sort the tools and lay out the easy fixes first. I’ll just jump in where it’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive pinned down pretty precisely—once you tell me the target spot, I can keep us on track. If you want, I can also map out the best route and timing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d help a lot—if we can keep it tight around school pickup, I’m in. Let’s start with the target spot and route.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—give me the exact target spot and I’ll lock the route around school pickup. I’ll keep it tight and efficient.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout already — everyone’s buzzing about it. I’ll let you know if I hear anything more solid.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great news — I’ll keep spreading the word and see if we can get even more folks involved. Let me know the moment you hear anything solid!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and tell you as soon as I get anything confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing, and by when?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly small stuff — loose fixtures, a few broken outlets, and one leaky pipe. If we can get it done by this weekend, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Which units or addresses are affected, and who’s coordinating the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m hearing the repair drive is the big thing, and I’m in. If we’re doing it, I’ll help spread the word and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d help a lot, Vik—thank you. I’m still catching up on everyone, but I’d love to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, then let’s keep it simple: I’ll spread the word and you can tell me where you need hands first. If the repair drive’s the plan, I’m ready to repeat it and get folks moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m going to post the latest repair-drive details in the group chat and make sure everyone has the updated time and location. If anything changes again, I’ll double-check it with you right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks. I’ll go with the updated time and location unless you tell me otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll treat that as the final update for now and only ping you if anything shifts again. Thanks for rolling with it, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m set on the repair drive plan we’ve got, Tess—let’s keep it simple and stick to the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, keepin’ it simple sounds smart. I’ll stick to the schedule and only pass along what’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds like I’m late again—what’s already decided for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still lining up the basics, but the main plan is to gather tools, split the houses, and start with the biggest fixes first. Once everyone’s here, I’ll repeat the plan again so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll grab what tools I can and take one of the house splits. Just flag me when you repeat the full list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in for the repair drive—just tell me where you need me and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll put you near the west side first. That’s the part I’m most sure still needs hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—I'll head to the west side and wait for your signal.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m on it — I’ll take the repair drive and keep it moving. Just send me the basics and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll send the basics over now, and I expect a clean update once you’ve got eyes on the repair drive. If anything shifts, tell me immediately and I’ll adjust the plan.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send the basics and I’ll keep you posted as soon as I’m on it. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in — I can help spread the word and pull a few people together for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That helps, Jules — thank you. I’d like to confirm the plan and details first so we’re not sharing anything unverified.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout, but I’m not sure if they’ve finalized everything yet. I’ll let you know if I hear the official word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I haven’t checked for updates yet, so I might be behind, but I can look now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah. Please do—I'd like to know where we stand on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m on it now—I'll check the latest and tell you where things stand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts already. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I catch any details about where they need help most.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Ira—keep me posted and I’ll pitch in wherever they need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus. If I hear which jobs are piling up first, I’ll swing by and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help out with the repair drive. Just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Start with the front fence and the loose step by the porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it — I’ll start with the front fence and then take a look at that loose porch step. I’ll let you know once I’ve got them squared away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to see the plan written down early, especially the pickup and drop-off details. Once the logistics are clear, I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fair—send me the pickup and drop-off specifics, and I’ll write the plan down clearly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I’ll send the pickup and drop-off details as soon as I have them, and then I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll spread the word right away and make sure everyone hears about the repair drive. The more neighbors we pull in, the better the turnout will be!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Quinn. I’ll add that to my list and keep an eye on the turnout.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll keep nudging folks all week so the word really gets around. If you want, I can also help remind anyone who’s on the fence.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need a bit more detail on what you want Faye to say about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—could you just say I’m happy to help with the repair drive, and I’ll bring whatever tools I can find?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, and I’ll bring whatever tools I can find.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m on it and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces from the neighbors, so I’m not sure yet. If you know the latest, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I don’t have a confirmed update yet, but I’m checking the group chat and I’ll share the latest as soon as I have it. If you hear anything first, please send it my way so I can keep everyone aligned.
